en.headline: Seven-year-old girl hurt by falling wood at Choi Wan Estate
en.dek: A circular wooden piece about five inches across struck the child outside Koon Yat House on Sunday afternoon; she was treated on site and declined hospital admission.
body: A seven-year-old girl was injured by a falling object outside Koon Yat House at Choi Wan Estate in Wong Tai Sin on Sunday afternoon.

Police received a report from a security guard at about 4.52pm. Officers established that a circular piece of wood roughly five inches in diameter had fallen from height and struck the girl on the hand. She received treatment at the scene and declined to go to hospital.
The case has been classified as falling object causing injury and is being handled by the Wong Tai Sin District Crime Squad. No one has been arrested.

zh.headline: 彩雲邨觀日樓木塊墮下擊傷7歲女童
zh.dek: 周日下午約5時直徑約5吋圓形木塊從高處墮下，女童手部受傷，治理後拒絕送院。
body: 黃大仙彩雲邨觀日樓對開周日下午發生高空墮物，一名7歲女童手部受傷。
警方約下午4時52分接獲保安員報案。初步調查相信一塊直徑約5吋的圓形木塊從大廈高處墮下擊中女童。她接受治理後拒絕送院。
案件列作高空墮物有人受傷，交由黃大仙警區刑事調查隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
